questions.text: Do you live in a house or an apartment?

cueCard.topic: Describe a place you have visited that you would like to visit again.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you would like to go there again.

questions.text: Describe a place you have visited that you would like to visit again.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a place you have visited that you would like to visit again. You should say: where the place is; when you went there; what you did there; and explain why you would like to go there again.

questions.text: Would you like to go there with the same people next time?
questions.say: Thank you. Would you like to go there with the same people next time?

questions.text: Why do you think people enjoy visiting new places?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a place you would like to visit again, and I'd like to discuss some more general questions related to this. Why do you think people enjoy visiting new places?

questions.text: Is it better to travel with friends or with your family? Why?
questions.say: Is it better to travel with friends or with your family? Why?

questions.text: How has tourism changed the place where you live, or a place you know well?

questions.text: Some people say that tourism does more harm than good to famous places. Do you agree?
